archetypes.name: dyn-static-resolver
archetypes.rationale: Static import and attribute-chain resolution is the highest-risk logic in the new lint.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the new monkeypatch facade-binding lint's static module resolution. Check alias imports, from-imports, dotted-string targets, relative import reporting, and the attribute-specific import-only classifier. Pay special attention to false positives from resolving submodules or consumer-module local bindings. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
